methodology.UserFees: All swap, outbound and affiliate fees paid by users when swapping through THORChain (slashing is paid by nodes, not users).
methodology.Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools, gross outbound fees and slashing fees paid into the Reserve, and affiliate fees charged by interfaces/wallets (affiliate fees are attributed to the THORChain native chain). RUNE block-reward emissions and the native tx fee (counted in the THORChain chain fees adapter) are excluded.
methodology.Revenue: The share of swap fees burned as RUNE (1% since 2026-09-12, 5% before) - value to all RUNE holders - plus protocol-kept income (outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees, developer fund, marketing fund and the 20% directed into protocol-owned liquidity). The node-bonder share of swap fees is treated as a security cost and the LP, affiliate and TCY shares as supplier payments, so none of those count as revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Income kept by the protocol: outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees paid into the Reserve, plus the 5% developer fund, 5% marketing fund and 20% protocol-owned liquidity taken from swap fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Value to RUNE holders: the share of swap fees burned as RUNE (1% since 2026-09-12, 5% before), permanently removed from supply - the only component that accrues to every RUNE holder.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Value paid to suppliers: the node-operator (RUNE bonder) share of swap fees set by the Incentive Pendulum (a security cost), the liquidity-provider share of swap fees (LP side of the Incentive Pendulum), affiliate fees passed through to integrators, the 10% of swap fees paid to TCY stakers, and the outbound gas costs reimbursed from the Reserve to nodes.

Fees.Swap Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools.
Fees.Outbound Fees: Gross outbound fees charged to users and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Fees.Slashing Fees: Fees slashed from misbehaving nodes and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Fees.Affiliate Fees: Fees charged by the interface or wallet that built the swap (attributed to the THORChain native chain).

UserFees.Swap Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools.
UserFees.Outbound Fees: Gross outbound fees charged to users and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
UserFees.Affiliate Fees: Fees charged by the interface or wallet that built the swap (attributed to the THORChain native chain).

Revenue.RUNE Burn: Share of swap fees burned, permanently removing RUNE from supply (5% from 2024-09-16, 1% from 2026-09-12).
Revenue.Outbound Fees: Outbound fees kept by the protocol: gross outbound fees charged to users minus the gas reimbursed to nodes, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Revenue.Slashing Fees: Fees slashed from misbehaving nodes and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Revenue.Developer Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the developer fund (since 2024-09-16).
Revenue.Marketing Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the marketing fund (since 2025-11-04).
Revenue.Protocol Owned Liquidity: 20% of swap fees the Reserve directs into protocol-owned liquidity (since 2026-09-01).

ProtocolRevenue.Outbound Fees: Outbound fees kept by the protocol: gross outbound fees charged to users minus the gas reimbursed to nodes, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
ProtocolRevenue.Slashing Fees: Fees slashed from misbehaving nodes and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
ProtocolRevenue.Developer Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the developer fund (since 2024-09-16).
ProtocolRevenue.Marketing Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the marketing fund (since 2025-11-04).
ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Owned Liquidity: 20% of swap fees the Reserve directs into protocol-owned liquidity (since 2026-09-01).

HoldersRevenue.RUNE Burn: Share of swap fees burned, permanently removing RUNE from supply and accruing value to RUNE holders (5% from 2024-09-16, 1% from 2026-09-12).

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To RUNE Bonders: Node operators' (RUNE bonders') share of swap fees, set network-wide by the Incentive Pendulum - a security cost paid to the nodes that bond RUNE to secure the network.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: Liquidity providers' share of swap fees (the LP side of the Incentive Pendulum).
SupplySideRevenue.Affiliate Fees To Integrators: Affiliate fees passed through to the integrator that built the swap.
SupplySideRevenue.TCY Staker Rewards: 10% of swap fees paid in RUNE to TCY stakers (since 2025-05-01).
SupplySideRevenue.Gas Reimbursement: Outbound gas costs reimbursed from the Reserve to the nodes that broadcast outbound transactions, paid out of the gross outbound fee.

methodology.Fees: 6% on every BidRouter swap-back and marketplace sale, plus (until 2026-07-23) 5% of each claw pull taken by V1/V2 machines at play time. Fees.Marketplace Fees: 6% on every P2P collectible sale through BidRouter; on Solana, the same 6% paid by the Core royalties plugin, split across Beezie's platform-fee and creator wallets

methodology.Fees: On Solana: total trading fees paid by users when swapping against Bags DBC pools (pre-migration) and DAMMv2 pools (post-migration), excluding the underlying Meteora protocol fee, DAMMv2 LP fees and any referral fees. On Robinhood Chain: token creation fees plus gross trading fees charged on Bags bonding-curve swaps (pre-migration) and Uniswap v4 hook swaps (post-migration) across the V1, V2 and V3 deployments. V1/V2 pools are quoted in WETH; each V3 launch sets its own 1-10% buy and sell fees, and its fees are counted in its quote asset: WETH or an allowlisted ERC-20 (e.g. tokenized stocks).

methodology.Revenue: Bags' net share: on Solana, trading-fee revenue from DBC (pre-migration) and DAMMv2 (post-migration); on Robinhood Chain, token creation fees plus the protocol share of trading fees net of the partner cut: 50% of gross on V1/V2 (partner cut on V2 pools with a partner), and on V3 max(20% of the fee, 0.5% of volume) per side, minus a partner cut of the launch's snapshotted partnerFeeBps (25% by default) of that share on pools with a partner.

methodology.Fees: Gross user-paid spend on render jobs under the Burn-Mint Equilibrium model (RNP-001). Each job is priced in USD; an equivalent USD value of RENDER is burned on the Solana SPL mint by the burn wallet. The on-chain burn represents the 95% node-operator side of gross job spend; gross fees are derived by dividing the burn value by 0.95. The remaining 5% Network Operator service fee is paid to OTOY off-chain per the Foundation's documented fee schedule and is not directly observed in the on-chain burn stream. Legacy Ethereum RNDR (pre-2023-11-02 Solana migration) is out of scope.

methodology.Fees: 1.50% of every bonding curve trade, charged on the quote side. Covers all four legs the curve program reports: the user.fun partner share, the coin creator share, Meteora's protocol share and the referral share paid to whichever interface hosted the swap.
methodology.UserFees: The same 1.50%. It is the whole of what a trader pays on a user.fun trade.
methodology.Revenue: The user.fun partner share only, which is 0.90% of a trade: the 1.20% the curve accumulates after Meteora's protocol share, less the coin creator's 25% of it. user.fun's own configuration records an effective rate of 0.96%, which is this 0.90% plus the 0.06% referral leg Meteora returns to whichever interface hosted the swap. That leg is counted in Fees and not here, because the swap event does not name the referral account and so cannot show which trades it was ours to claim.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue (0.9% of the trade). user.fun has no separate holder or treasury leg on chain.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Everything user.fun does not keep, which is 0.60% of a trade: the coin creator's 25% of the 1.20% curve fee, plus Meteora's 0.30% protocol share and the referral leg inside it paid to whichever interface hosted the swap.

methodology.Fees: Everything paid to trade on Ride Markets, in USDC: a fee when a trade is opened, a fee when it settles, and the share of the profit paid to the caller who deployed the trade.
methodology.Revenue: The opening and settlement fees, which the protocol keeps.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The opening and settlement fees, which the protocol keeps.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The profit share paid to callers, which never reaches the protocol.

Fees.Trade Opening Fees: Charged when a trade is opened, based on its volume. Taken by the frontend as a direct USDC transfer to the fee wallet, outside the Trade Executor program, so it is counted only in transactions that invoke that program (including CPI `create_intent`) and only for what the settlement fees do not already account for.
Fees.Settlement Fees: Charged by the Trade Executor program when a trade settles: 0.7% of the USDC returned to the treasury, plus a cut of the caller's profit share.
Fees.Caller Profit Share: Paid out of the treasury's realised profit to the caller who deployed the trade, at a rate the DAO sets. The protocol sets and enforces this rate but does not receive it.

Revenue.Trade Opening Fees To Protocol: All trade opening fees are paid to the Ride Markets fee wallet.
Revenue.Settlement Fees To Protocol: All settlement fees are paid to the Ride Markets fee wallet.

ProtocolRevenue.Trade Opening Fees To Protocol: All trade opening fees are paid to the Ride Markets fee wallet.
ProtocolRevenue.Settlement Fees To Protocol: All settlement fees are paid to the Ride Markets fee wallet.

SupplySideRevenue.Caller Profit Share To Callers: Paid straight from the trade's proceeds to the caller, as the cost of sourcing the trade.

methodology.Revenue: The round protocol fee plus 10% of each winning SOL ad bid and all of each winning ATTN ad bid, sent to the protocol treasury.

methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 90% of each winning SOL ad bid forwarded into that tile's jackpot vault, paid to the tile's bidders on a jackpot hit.

Fees.Round Protocol Fee: Protocol fee taken from each round's tile deposits at close (10% at launch, snapshotted per round).
Fees.Ad Auction Bids: Winning bid of each weekly tile ad auction at settlement, in SOL or ATTN.

ProtocolRevenue.Round Protocol Fee To Treasury: Round protocol fee sent to the protocol treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Ad Auction Fee To Treasury: 10% of each winning SOL ad bid and 100% of each winning ATTN ad bid sent to the protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Ad Auction Bids To Tile Jackpots: 90% of each winning SOL ad bid forwarded into that tile's jackpot vault.

methodology.Fees: Gross LP trading fees claimed by Valhalla-managed Meteora DLMM positions. Each public Meteora claim event is counted only when its transaction contains Valhalla's matching post-workflow management-fee transfer; claim assets are measured directly, not inferred from a fee rate. DAMM v2 and opening fees are excluded.

Fees.Meteora DLMM LP Fees Claimed: Gross LP trading fees paid out by decoded Meteora DLMM claim events in attributable Valhalla transactions.

methodology.Fees: Flat SOL fees paid by users to create a token, manage a token, create an OpenBook market and bulk send tokens on DexLab, received by the DexLab fee wallet on Solana.
methodology.Revenue: All fees (SOL paid by users to create a token, manage a token, create an OpenBook market and bulk send tokens on DexLab) are kept by DexLab. There is no supplier side and no token holder share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All fees (SOL paid by users to create a token, manage a token, create an OpenBook market and bulk send tokens on DexLab) are kept by DexLab. There is no supplier side and no token holder share.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: All flat SOL fees received by the DexLab fee wallet on Solana, retained entirely by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: All flat SOL fees received by the DexLab fee wallet on Solana, retained entirely by the protocol.

methodology.Fees: Everything traders pay copyfomo on every copied buy and sell (a 2% service fee plus the gas copyfomo fronts for them, billed back as one stablecoin transfer to the copyfomo treasury, counted on the day the fee is collected), plus the creator fees of the copyfomo token $COPY: the Pons launchpad hook takes 3% of every swap of the COPY/COIN pool on Robinhood Chain, of which 2.7% goes to the creator (1% hook fee, 70% to the creator, plus a 2% creator tax). Counted on the day of the trade, valued at the hourly COIN price. The fees are swept into COIN by Pons and claimed by copyfomo in batches later; the claims are not what is counted.
methodology.UserFees: The part paid by copyfomo users: service fee plus gas billed back. Excludes the $COPY creator fees, which are paid by $COPY traders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Referral rewards paid to copyfomo referrers, plus the actual on-chain cost copyfomo pays on users' behalf: the EVM bundler gas and the SOL spent by the Solana fee payer (transaction fees and token-account rent).
methodology.Revenue: Fees minus SupplySideRevenue, i.e. after the EVM bundler gas, the Solana fee payer cost and referral rewards: the service fee plus copyfomo's margin on gas, plus the $COPY creator fees (the 'token fees' figure on copyfomo.com/data). The 'protocol fees, after gas' figure on copyfomo.com/data is the service part before referral rewards.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Buyback & burn of $COPY, funded by the creator fees: what the copyfomo creator wallets pay (COIN or USDG) in every transaction where they buy $COPY from the pool and burn $COPY in the same transaction (the buyback account buys and burns in one user operation). Counted on the day of the buy, which follows the trades that generated the fees. A holder cashback leg (USDG distributed to $COPY holders) is planned and will be added when it goes live.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue minus HoldersRevenue: service revenue and the creator fees kept by copyfomo.

Fees.Treasury inflow: Every stablecoin transfer into the copyfomo treasury. The service fee and the gas billed back to the trader arrive together in one transfer and cannot be split on-chain.
Fees.$COPY creator fees: 2.7% of the COIN leg of every swap of the COPY/COIN Uniswap v4 pool on Robinhood Chain (PoolManager Swap events of the pool), valued at the hourly COIN price on Dune. Rate from the hook's launch config: 1% hook fee with 70% to the creator, plus a 2% creator tax.

UserFees.Treasury inflow: Same as the Fees component: everything copyfomo users pay.

SupplySideRevenue.Referral rewards: USDC sent by the copyfomo referral payout wallet on Base to referrers (its top-ups from the treasury are internal and excluded), plus any stablecoin sent by the treasury back to identified copyfomo user wallets.
SupplySideRevenue.Bundler gas cost: Gas the copyfomo bundler wallets paid to the ERC-4337 EntryPoint for users' operations, priced with the daily WETH / WBNB price.
SupplySideRevenue.Solana fee payer cost: SOL spent by the copyfomo Solana fee payer, which signs every copyfomo Solana transaction: signature fees and the rent of the token accounts it creates, net of rent returned on close (its balance change in its own transactions, excluding its top-ups co-signed by the Solana treasury), priced with the daily SOL price.

HoldersRevenue.Buyback & burn: COIN and USDG sent by the copyfomo creator wallets in every transaction that swaps on the COPY/COIN pool, delivers $COPY to them and burns $COPY from them (Transfer to the zero address) in that same transaction, since 2026-09-11 when the buyback programme started. The three manual buys of 2026-09-11, burned the next day in one transaction (hash in the query helper), are listed explicitly.

Revenue.Treasury inflow: Same as the Fees component: gross service fees before the supply-side deductions.
Revenue.$COPY creator fees: Same as the Fees component: creator fees have no supply-side share.
Revenue.Referral rewards: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.
Revenue.Bundler gas cost: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.
Revenue.Solana fee payer cost: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Buyback & burn: Same as the HoldersRevenue component, subtracted from Revenue.

methodology.Fees: Trade fees on every buy/sell of Dynamito tokens (1-3% tier plus the anti-snipe surcharge in the first 5 seconds) and the 3% blast-off fee at graduation.
methodology.Revenue: 40% of trade fees plus 50% of blast-off fees, kept by Dynamito.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue (40% of trade fees plus 50% of blast-off fees): all of it is kept by the Dynamito treasury. No token holder distribution yet; when the $TNT buyback programme starts, its share will be reported as HoldersRevenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 40% of trade fees and 50% of blast-off fees paid to creators, plus the 20% of trade fees paid to the Meteora protocol.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Bonding-curve trade fees paid by traders on every buy and sell (1% standard, 2% or 3% on higher-fee tiers chosen by the creator).
Fees.Anti-snipe Fees: Extra fee paid by buyers in the first 5 seconds after a launch (99% decaying to the base tier, on-chain fee schedule).
Fees.Blast-off Fees: 3% fee on the 85 SOL pot when a token graduates from the curve to the open market.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees: 40% of trade fees (including the anti-snipe surcharge) kept by Dynamito.
Revenue.Blast-off Fees: 50% of the blast-off fee kept by Dynamito.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees: Same as Revenue: 40% of trade fees kept by Dynamito treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Blast-off Fees: 50% of the blast-off fee kept by Dynamito.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: 40% of trade fees paid to token creators, claimable on-chain.
SupplySideRevenue.Blast-off Fees: 50% of the blast-off fee paid to the token creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Meteora Protocol Fees: 20% of trade fees paid to the Meteora protocol that runs the curve.

methodology.Fees: Trading fees collected by vibes.fun: the 1% platform fee on every trade against the Raydium LaunchLab bonding curves it configures, and, once a coin graduates, the quote-side trading fees of its permanently locked liquidity, harvested with the Fee Key vibes.fun holds. Raydium's own protocol fee is excluded. Amounts are in each pool's quote token.
methodology.UserFees: Same as fees, paid by traders.
methodology.Revenue: 30% of fees: the share vibes.fun keeps, split between its treasury and $VIBES buyback and burn.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 15% of fees, sent to the vibes.fun treasury (Squads multisig).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 15% of fees, used to buy back and burn $VIBES.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 70% of fees, paid to the holders of the coin that generated them, or to its creator when the creator chose creator fees.

Fees.Trading Fees: 1% of every LaunchLab bonding curve trade on a vibes.fun launch, charged in the pool's quote token.
Fees.LP Fees: Quote-token fees harvested from the locked liquidity of graduated vibes.fun launches.

Revenue.Trading Fees: 30% of bonding curve platform fees, kept by vibes.fun.
Revenue.LP Fees: 30% of harvested locked liquidity fees, kept by vibes.fun.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: 15% of bonding curve platform fees, sent to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.LP Fees: 15% of harvested locked liquidity fees, sent to the treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 15% of fees spent buying $VIBES back and burning it.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees: 70% of bonding curve platform fees, paid to the holders of the coin that generated them or to its creator.
SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: 70% of harvested locked liquidity fees, paid to the holders of the coin or to its creator.

methodology.Fees: 1% (100 bps) app fee charged on swaps routed through Relay, collected in USDC. Reported per origin chain of the swap.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Identical to Revenue: the full app fee is kept by the protocol.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of these fees go to HyperDex.

Revenue.Hinkal partner fee: HyperDex's 10 bp partner fee on Hinkal private swaps.
Revenue.CoW partner fee: HyperDex's 15 bp partner fee on CoW Swap orders.

ProtocolRevenue.Hinkal partner fee: HyperDex's 10 bp partner fee on Hinkal private swaps.
ProtocolRevenue.CoW partner fee: HyperDex's 15 bp partner fee on CoW Swap orders.

methodology.Revenue: 0.5% protocol fee on shielded pool deposits and 0.5% on withdrawals (Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, Avalanche, Solana), deposit check fees on Solana, plus ZEC rewards received by the Nullmask team wallet from MASK token holder distributions (Solana).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 0.5% protocol fee on shielded pool deposits and 0.5% on withdrawals (Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, Avalanche, Solana), deposit check fees on Solana, plus ZEC rewards received by the Nullmask team wallet from MASK token holder distributions (Solana).

Fees.Deposit/Withdraw Fees: 0.5% protocol fee charged on shielded pool deposits and withdrawals (ProtocolFeeCharged events on EVM; ProtocolFeeCharged and TokenFeeCharged events of the Solana program, kind 0 and 1). Relayer gas compensation is excluded.
Fees.Deposit Check Fees: Solana: fee charged for the AML check of a deposit that is refused or cancelled (ProtocolFeeCharged and TokenFeeCharged events, kind 2).
Fees.MASK Holder Rewards: ZEC rewards received by the Nullmask team wallet from the StonkFun rewards distributor for holding MASK. Other ZEC transfers to the wallet are excluded.

methodology.Fees: Copy trading fees fomo-mcp users pay on every copied buy and sell (1% on copies under $100, 0.5% from $100), plus the creator fees of the fomo-mcp token $FOMOMCP on the Pons launchpad.
methodology.UserFees: Copy trading fees paid by fomo-mcp users. Excludes the $FOMOMCP creator fees, which are paid by $FOMOMCP traders.
methodology.Revenue: All fees (copy trading fees and $FOMOMCP creator fees) are kept by fomo-mcp.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All fees (copy trading fees and $FOMOMCP creator fees) are kept by fomo-mcp.

Fees.Trading Fees: Copy trading fees on Solana, taken by Jupiter as a referral fee and received in fomo-mcp's Jupiter referral account (the 80% that reaches the account; Jupiter keeps 20%).
Fees.Creator Fees: ETH that Pons credits to the $FOMOMCP creator fee recipient in its fee escrow: the 2% creator tax and 70% of the 1% curve fee on the launch curve, then the creator share of the Pons hook fees on the Uniswap v4 pool after graduation. Counted when Pons sweeps and credits them.

methodology.Fees: Platform fees, integrator app fees and swap costs paid by users on Relay bridges and swaps, excluding execution costs (network gas).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: App fees paid to the integrators that add them, and swap costs paid to liquidity providers. Excludes the integrator revenue share of the platform fee, which Relay does not disclose.
methodology.Revenue: Platform fees. This is an upper bound: Relay pays qualifying integrators an undisclosed 0-67% revenue share out of it.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Platform fees kept by Relay. This is an upper bound: Relay pays qualifying integrators an undisclosed 0-67% revenue share out of it.

Fees.Swap Costs: Payments to liquidity providers for cross-asset and cross-chain swaps. Excludes trades with unreliable token prices.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Costs To Liquidity Providers: Swap costs paid to the liquidity providers that fill cross-asset and cross-chain swaps.

SupplySideRevenue.Platform Fee Revenue Share To Integrator: Relay pays qualifying integrators a revenue share of 0-67% of its platform fee, depending on the swap type and their 30-day volume. Relay does not report the amount, so it cannot be measured.

methodology.Fees: SOL service fees paid by users to Tsunammi for the Create Token flow.
methodology.Revenue: All tracked Create Token service fees are retained as Tsunammi protocol revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: SOL received by Tsunammi's dedicated Create Token fee collector.

Fees.Create Token Service Fees: SOL received by Tsunammi's public Create Token service-fee collector from external addresses.

Revenue.Create Token Service Fees: Create Token service fees retained by Tsunammi.

methodology.Volume: The USDC side of every swap on the bonding curves of tokens launched with Ryntra Launch (Meteora DBC pools on its configs, created by its pool payer), from the swap events. Trading after a token graduates is Meteora DAMM v2's volume and is not counted. Double counted: Meteora already lists this volume.
methodology.Fees: Everything traders pay on the bonding curves of tokens launched with Ryntra Launch (Meteora DBC pools on its configs, created by its pool payer), including the 20% Meteora keeps; after graduation, the referral fee Meteora pays Ryntra on trades made through Ryntra; and what Ryntra takes as the partner of a graduated curve (its share of the migration fee, and later the fees of the DAMM v2 liquidity locked for it) when its fee claimer withdraws them. The creator's share of the migration fee and the quote above the graduation threshold (not a fee) are not included.
methodology.UserFees: What traders pay: the bonding curve fee, the referral fee Ryntra earns on graduated-pool trades and the graduated pool's fees; not the migration fee, which comes out of the curve's reserve.
methodology.Revenue: Ryntra's 60% of the configs' share of the bonding curve fee, the referral fees Meteora pays it, and its graduation income when withdrawn.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Ryntra's 60% of the configs' share of the bonding curve fee, the referral fees Meteora pays it and its graduation income, all of it for the protocol: Ryntra has no token and distributes nothing to holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The token creator's 40% of the configs' share of the bonding curve fee, Meteora's protocol fee, and the referral fees Meteora pays other apps.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: The whole fee traders pay on every swap on the bonding curve of a token launched with Ryntra. It starts at 50% (protected config) or 20% (classic, micro) at launch to deter snipers and decays to 1% within minutes, plus a volatility fee. 80% goes to the configs (40% of it to the creator, 60% to Ryntra) and 20% to Meteora, which pays the referral fee out of its part.
Fees.Graduated Pool Referral Fees: The referral fee Meteora pays Ryntra, out of its protocol fee, on trades made through Ryntra in the pool a launch graduated into.
Fees.Graduation Fees: Ryntra's share of a graduating curve's migration fee — 60% of 2% on Classic and Protected, all of 8% on Micro — when withdrawn by its claimer (the vault, or on Micro Ryntra's launch executor).
Fees.Graduated Pool Fees: Fees of the DAMM v2 liquidity locked for Ryntra after a launch graduates, when claimed, in USDC and in the launched token.

UserFees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: The whole fee traders pay on the bonding curve.
UserFees.Graduated Pool Referral Fees: The referral fee, part of the fee traders pay Meteora in the graduated pool.
UserFees.Graduated Pool Fees: Fees traders pay to the DAMM v2 liquidity locked for Ryntra, when claimed.

Revenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Ryntra: Ryntra's 60% of the configs' 80% of the bonding curve fee.
Revenue.Referral Fees To Ryntra: The referral fee Meteora pays Ryntra on trades made through it, on the curve and in the graduated pool.
Revenue.Graduated Pool Fees To Ryntra: Claimed fees of the liquidity locked for Ryntra after graduation.

ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Ryntra: Ryntra's 60% of the configs' 80% of the bonding curve fee.
ProtocolRevenue.Referral Fees To Ryntra: The referral fee Meteora pays Ryntra on trades made through it, on the curve and in the graduated pool.
ProtocolRevenue.Graduated Pool Fees To Ryntra: Claimed fees of the liquidity locked for Ryntra after graduation.

SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Creators: The token creator's 40% of the configs' 80% of the bonding curve fee.
SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Meteora: Meteora's protocol fee: its 20% of the bonding curve fee, less the referral fee it pays.
SupplySideRevenue.Referral Fees To Other Apps: The referral fee Meteora pays other apps on curve trades made through them.

methodology.Volume: One side of every trade made through Ryntra. On Solana, from the trader's own token movements in the trade: the stablecoin they paid or received, else the SOL, else the token they paid — gross of Ryntra's fee (a fee taken from what they received is added back). On Arc, from the swap's own events: the side in USDC, EURC, WETH or cirBTC of a KyberSwap swap, gross of the router's fees (the amount the fee was taken from), and the input a trader sent Circle's swap Adapter. A trade is Ryntra's when it paid Ryntra's fee inside it. Trades on the bonding curve of a token launched with Ryntra are counted under Ryntra Launch. Double counted: the venues the trades are routed through already list this volume.
methodology.Fees: Fees people pay Ryntra on trades made through it. On Solana: what the swap router (Jupiter, or DFlow when Jupiter routes through it) pays into Ryntra's fee wallet and its Jupiter referral account inside the trade. On Arc: the developer fee of a Circle swap and the fee leg of a KyberSwap swap that name Ryntra's fee address, read from Circle's fee collector and KyberSwap's router events. Plain transfers into these accounts are not fees.
methodology.UserFees: Fees traders pay Ryntra inside the trades they make through it.
methodology.Revenue: Trading fees kept by Ryntra: the whole fee paid into its fee wallet on Solana and from KyberSwap on Arc, what reached its Jupiter referral account less Jupiter's 20% share, and the Circle developer fee less the share (about 10%) Circle's fee collector routes to its protocol recipient. Cashback and invite rewards are paid later, when people claim them, and are not deducted.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Trading fees kept by Ryntra, all of it for the protocol: Ryntra has no token and distributes nothing to holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Jupiter's 20% share of the fees that reached Ryntra's Jupiter referral account, and the share (about 10%) of the Circle developer fee that Circle's fee collector routes to its protocol recipient on Arc.

Fees.Trading Fees: Ryntra's fee on swaps and spot trades, paid into its fee wallet or its Jupiter referral account on Solana, or to its fee address on Arc, inside the trade.

UserFees.Trading Fees: Ryntra's fee on swaps and spot trades, paid by the trader inside the trade.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Ryntra: The whole fee paid into the fee wallet and from KyberSwap, 80% of what reached the Jupiter referral account, and what the Circle developer fee leaves Ryntra after the protocol share (about 90%).

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Ryntra: The whole fee paid into the fee wallet and from KyberSwap, 80% of what reached the Jupiter referral account, and what the Circle developer fee leaves Ryntra after the protocol share (about 90%).

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Jupiter: Jupiter's 20% share of the fees that reached Ryntra's Jupiter referral account.
SupplySideRevenue.Developer Fee Protocol Share: The share (about 10%) of the developer fee on a Circle swap that Circle's fee collector routes to its protocol recipient on Arc, read from the collector's event.

methodology.Volume: SOL paid by buyers and SOL paid out to sellers on the bonding curves, before fees.
methodology.Fees: Everything charged on the launchpad: DEEP's fee on each bonding-curve buy and sell (1.25%), the reward fee a token's creator chose at launch (0% to 5% of each trade), the fee to launch a token ($2, paid in SOL) and the migration fee taken from the SOL a curve raised when its token graduates (1%, less the network rent of the new pool's accounts).
methodology.Revenue: DEEP's share: its 1.25% fee on bonding-curve trades, the token launch fees and the migration fees. Reward fees are not included.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: DEEP's 1.25% fee on bonding-curve trades, the token launch fees and the migration fees, all paid into DEEP's on-chain fee vault, which pays 10% to the team that builds DEEP and 90% to the DEEP treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The reward fee of each token, paid in full to the token's creator or, for a Holder Rewards token, to the holders of that token.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: DEEP's fee on each bonding-curve buy and sell (1.25%).
Fees.Bonding Curve Creator Rewards: The reward fee of Creator Rewards tokens (a rate the creator chose at launch, up to 5% of each trade).
Fees.Bonding Curve Holder Rewards: The reward fee of Holder Rewards tokens (a rate the creator chose at launch, up to 5% of each trade).
Fees.Token Launch Fees: The fee to launch a token ($2, paid in SOL at the Pyth SOL/USD price).
Fees.Migration Fees: The part of the SOL a curve raised that DEEP keeps when the token graduates to DeepSwap (1%, less the network rent of the new pool's accounts).

Revenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: DEEP's fee on each bonding-curve buy and sell (1.25%).
Revenue.Token Launch Fees: The fee to launch a token.
Revenue.Migration Fees: The migration fee DEEP keeps when a token graduates.

ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: DEEP's fee on each bonding-curve buy and sell (1.25%), paid into DEEP's fee vault.
ProtocolRevenue.Token Launch Fees: The fee to launch a token, paid into DEEP's fee vault.
ProtocolRevenue.Migration Fees: The migration fee DEEP keeps when a token graduates, paid into DEEP's fee vault.

SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Creator Rewards: Reward fees paid to the creators of Creator Rewards tokens.
SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Holder Rewards: Reward fees paid to the holders of Holder Rewards tokens.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by users
methodology.Fees: Everything charged on DeepSwap: the swap fee (0.35% of a buy and 0.75% of a sell), the reward fee the pool charges on top of it (0% to 5%, fixed when the pool was created) and the flat fee in SOL to open a pool. Pools of graduated launchpad tokens are opened by the launchpad, which pays that fee out of the token's migration fee; it is reported with the launchpad, not here.
methodology.Revenue: DEEP's share of the swap fee (0.25% of a buy, 0.65% of a sell) and the pool creation fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: DEEP's share of the swap fee (0.25% of a buy, 0.65% of a sell) and the pool creation fees, all paid into DEEP's on-chain fee vault, which pays 10% to the team that builds DEEP and 90% to the DEEP treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The liquidity providers' share of the swap fee (0.10% of each swap, left in the pool) and each pool's reward fee, paid in full to the pool's creator or, on a Holder Rewards pool, to the holders of the pool's token.
methodology.Volume: The quote-token side (SOL on a TOKEN/SOL pool) of every swap, before fees.

Fees.Protocol Fees: DEEP's share of the swap fee (0.25% of a buy, 0.65% of a sell).
Fees.LP Fees: The liquidity providers' share of the swap fee (0.10% of each swap).
Fees.Creator Rewards: The reward fee of Creator Rewards pools (a rate fixed when the pool was created, up to 5% of each swap).
Fees.Holder Rewards: The reward fee of Holder Rewards pools (a rate fixed when the pool was created, up to 5% of each swap).
Fees.Pool Creation Fees: The flat fee in SOL to open a pool, except pools opened by the DEEP launchpad for graduated tokens.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: DEEP's share of the swap fee (0.25% of a buy, 0.65% of a sell).
Revenue.Pool Creation Fees: The flat fee in SOL to open a pool.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: DEEP's share of the swap fee, paid into DEEP's fee vault.
ProtocolRevenue.Pool Creation Fees: The flat fee in SOL to open a pool, paid into DEEP's fee vault.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: The liquidity providers' share of the swap fee, left in the pool.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Rewards: Reward fees paid to the creators of Creator Rewards pools.
SupplySideRevenue.Holder Rewards: Reward fees paid to the holders of the token of Holder Rewards pools.

methodology.Fees: Trading fees paid by users on every Vaultex coin: 2% of each buy and sell on the bonding curve, in the coin's quote asset (SOL, USDC and more), read from Meteora DBC swap events. Most of it goes to the coin creator, split by the creator percentage of each Vaultex pool config (DBC create-config event).
methodology.Revenue: Vaultex's share of the trading fee on every bonding-curve trade, claimed into the Vaultex treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Vaultex's share of the trading fee on every bonding-curve trade, claimed into the Vaultex treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The coin creator's share of every trade (which creators can share with their holders through Drip and Drop), Meteora's protocol fee, and the referral fee paid to the frontend that hosted the swap.

Most of it goes to the coin creator, split by the creator percentage of each Vaultex pool config (DBC create-config event).

Revenue.Trading Fees to Vaultex: Vaultex share of bonding-curve trade fees, claimable by the Vaultex fee claimer.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees to Vaultex: Same as Revenue, all of it goes to the Vaultex treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees to Creators: Trade fees paid to coin creators.
SupplySideRevenue.Referral Fees: Referral fees paid to hosting frontends.

methodology.Fees: The 0.5% fee users pay on every swap made through Monolith Exchange, collected by Jupiter into Monolith's referral fee accounts.
methodology.UserFees: The 0.5% fee users pay on every swap made through Monolith Exchange.
methodology.Revenue: The 80% of the 0.5% swap fee that Monolith Exchange keeps after Jupiter's 20% share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 80% of the 0.5% swap fee that goes to the Monolith Exchange treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 20% of the 0.5% swap fee that Jupiter keeps as the routing provider.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: 0.5% fee on swaps routed through Jupiter, collected in the fee mint Jupiter selects.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: 0.5% fee on swaps routed through Jupiter, paid by users.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Monolith: 80% of the 0.5% swap fee, kept by Monolith Exchange.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Monolith: 80% of the 0.5% swap fee, kept by Monolith Exchange.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Jupiter: 20% of the 0.5% swap fee, kept by Jupiter.

methodology.Volume: USDC players spend opening Raflux gacha packs of physical trading cards (Super Gacha on Solana, FluxBox on Base), at the full pack price including any part covered by a coupon. Packs are sold at fixed prices of 10, 25, 50 and 100 USDC (1 USDC packs on Base at launch); each pack pulls a physical card, often with a USDC bonus, that the player can ship home or sell back for USDC.
methodology.Fees: Pack purchases minus USDC returned to players: refunds of cancelled pulls, card cash-outs, sell-backs, USDC prizes and reimbursed card shipments. This is the 10% fee Raflux keeps when a card is exchanged for USDC plus the game result of pulls, so it is negative on days when players win more than they pay.
methodology.Revenue: Pack purchases minus USDC returned to players, kept by Raflux. No share goes to LPs, referrers or token holders.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Pack purchases minus USDC returned to players, all of it sent to the Raflux treasury.

Fees.Pack Purchases: USDC players spend opening packs, at the full pack price including any part covered by a coupon.
Fees.Buybacks: USDC returned to players: refunds of cancelled pulls, card cash-outs, sell-backs, USDC prizes and reimbursed card shipments.

Revenue.Pack Purchases: USDC players spend opening packs, kept by Raflux before player payouts.
Revenue.Buybacks: USDC returned to players, subtracted from revenue kept by Raflux.

ProtocolRevenue.Pack Purchases: USDC players spend opening packs, sent to the Raflux treasury before player payouts.
ProtocolRevenue.Buybacks: USDC returned to players, subtracted from treasury revenue.

SupplySideRevenue.Card Procurement, Grading & Vaulting: The platform buys the physical cards behind its packs and pays to grade, ship and vault them. These costs are paid offchain and not disclosed.

methodology.Volume: DEX Volume: Cash volume: USDC collateral paid by traders on BUYs and received on SELLs (gross_amount of every successful settle_fill instruction). Counts the trader side only; the house counterparty leg is not counted. Volume follows the live match calendar, so days with no live fixtures show zero by design.
methodology.Fees: On-chain BUY fee from FillEvent (SELLs and settlements are fee-free).
methodology.UserFees: On-chain BUY fee from FillEvent, paid by traders (SELLs and settlements are fee-free).
methodology.Revenue: 100% protocol revenue — no LPs, no token, no revenue share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 100% protocol revenue — no LPs, no token, no revenue share.

Fees.Trading Fees: Fee charged on BUY fills (ceil(gross * fee_bps / 10000), currently 1.5%).

UserFees.Trading Fees: Fee charged on BUY fills, paid by traders.

Revenue.Trading Fees: Fee charged on BUY fills, 100% to the protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: Fee charged on BUY fills, 100% to the protocol treasury.

methodology.Fees: The service fee copypump charges on every copied buy and sell, collected as a USDC transfer to the copypump treasury and counted on the day it is collected (the collector batches fees per user, so a fee can land the day after its trade).
methodology.UserFees: The service fees copypump charges on every copied buy and sell, collected as a USDC transfer to the copypump treasury and counted on the day it is collected (the collector batches fees per user, so a fee can land the day after its trade).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The cost copypump pays on users' behalf: the SOL the copypump fee payer loses co-signing every copied trade (signature fee, priority fee, rent of the token accounts the route creates), net of the rent it recovers when the emptied accounts are closed back to it. Priced at the daily SOL price.
methodology.Revenue: Fees minus the fee payer cost: what copypump keeps. The 'app revenue, after gas' figure on copypumpfun.com/data.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees minus the fee payer cost: what copypump keeps.

Fees.Service fee: Every USDC transfer into the copypump treasury on Solana.

UserFees.Service fee: Every USDC transfer into the copypump treasury on Solana.

SupplySideRevenue.Fee payer cost: SOL the fee payer lost in the transactions it signed: fees and the rent of the token accounts it creates, net of the rent it gets back when copypump closes the emptied accounts to it (since 2026-10-13). Its top-ups from the treasury are co-signed by the treasury and excluded; failed transactions are included since their fee is paid. Priced with the daily SOL price.

Revenue.Service fee: The service fee net of the fee payer cost of the same day: what copypump keeps.

ProtocolRevenue.Service fee: The service fee net of the fee payer cost of the same day: what copypump keeps.

methodology.Fees: The 1% bonding curve trading fee on every Ferzan coin before it graduates (Meteora's DBC fee on Solana, including Meteora's protocol share).
methodology.UserFees: The 1% fee paid by traders on every Ferzan coin before it graduates.
methodology.Revenue: Ferzan's share of the curve fee: 50%, less 10% to a referrer when one is set. On Solana, half of the DBC trading fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Ferzan's share of the curve fee: 50%, less 10% to a referrer when one is set. On Solana, half of the DBC trading fee.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The coin creator's 50%, referrer payouts, and on Solana Meteora's protocol fee.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: None.

Fees.Meteora Protocol Fees: Meteora's protocol fee on Ferzan's Solana curves.

UserFees.Meteora Protocol Fees: Meteora's protocol fee on Ferzan's Solana curves.

ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Fees To Ferzan: Ferzan's share of the curve fee.

SupplySideRevenue.Meteora Protocol Fees: Meteora's protocol fee on Solana curves.

methodology.Fees: Fees paid by traders of coins launched on Incognito Launchpad (Solana): the launchpad's 0.25% platform fee and the coin creator's 0.5% fee on every trade against the Raydium LaunchLab bonding curves it configures, and, once a coin graduates, the quote-side trading fees of its permanently locked liquidity, harvested with the Fee Key the launchpad holds. methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 0.25% platform fee on bonding-curve trades and the harvested locked-liquidity fees, all sent to the launchpad treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator fee of each bonding-curve trade, paid to the wallet that launched the coin.

Revenue.LP Fees To Protocol: The harvested locked-liquidity fees, kept by the launchpad.

ProtocolRevenue.LP Fees To Protocol: The harvested locked-liquidity fees, sent to the launchpad treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Creators: The 0.5% creator fee on bonding curve trades, paid to the wallet that launched the coin.

UserFees.Trading Fees: 0.75% fee on each swap between SOL and a token made in Peep, paid by the user.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Treasury: The whole 0.75% swap fee, kept by Peep.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Treasury: The whole 0.75% swap fee, sent to the Peep treasury.

methodology.Fees: Fees charged when positions settle: a 0.5 basis point close charge on the order value plus the market fee (currently 2%) on the gain of winning trades and on the loss of losing and liquidated trades. Opening a position is free and there are no funding payments.
methodology.Revenue: All settlement fees, split between the protocol and CARDBOARD stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Half of settlement fees, allocated to the protocol fee recipient.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Half of settlement fees, distributed in USDC to CARDBOARD stakers. Referral bonuses are paid from the same budget and are not separated.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs revenue

Fees.Close Fees: Fees on positions closed by their owner: the 0.5 basis point close charge on the order value plus the market fee on the gain of a winning trade or on the house's gain from a losing one.
Fees.Liquidation Fees: Market fee on the margin forfeited by liquidated positions, including closes that executed past the bust price.

Revenue.Trading Fees To CARDBOARD Stakers: Half of settlement fees, put into the USDC rewards budget for CARDBOARD stakers.
Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: Half of settlement fees, allocated to the protocol fee recipient.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: Half of settlement fees, allocated to the protocol fee recipient.

HoldersRevenue.Trading Fees To CARDBOARD Stakers: Half of settlement fees, put into the USDC rewards budget for CARDBOARD stakers.

methodology.Fees: Profit fee of 2% on the gain of every winning trade, taken from the payout. Opening a position, losing trades and liquidations are free and there is no funding. The house bankroll's trading profit is not counted.
methodology.Revenue: All profit fees, kept by Jupiter in a fee balance of the YOLO program separate from the house bankroll; there are no liquidity providers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Half of profit fees, kept by Jupiter.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Half of profit fees, used to buy back JUP under Jupiter's policy of spending 50% of revenue on JUP buybacks.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs revenue

Fees.Profit Fees: 2% of the gain on each winning trade, deducted from the payout the trader receives.

Revenue.Profit Fees To Jupiter: Half of profit fees, kept by Jupiter.
Revenue.Token Buy Back: Half of profit fees, used to buy back JUP.

ProtocolRevenue.Profit Fees To Jupiter: Half of profit fees, kept by Jupiter.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Half of profit fees, used to buy back JUP.

methodology.Fees: Management and performance fees paid by vault investors (the manager's and FBYT's parts), plus the SOL trading fee paid on every vault swap and the SOL fee paid to create a vault.
methodology.UserFees: All fees: investors pay the management and performance fees, managers (or their trading delegates) pay the trading and vault creation fees.
methodology.Revenue: FBYT's share of the management and performance fees, plus all trading and vault creation fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: FBYT's share of the management and performance fees, plus all trading and vault creation fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The money managers' share of the management and performance fees.

Fees.Management Fees: Yearly management fee on the vault's assets, set per vault by its manager, paid in the vault's tokens when it is paid out to the manager.
Fees.Performance Fees: Fee on the investor's profit above their high-water mark, set per vault by its manager, charged when the investor withdraws.

Fees.Vault Creation Fees: SOL fee paid by the money manager to create a vault (0.002 SOL).

UserFees.Trading Fees: Paid by the money manager or their trading delegate.

Revenue.Management Fees To FBYT: FBYT's protocol share of the management fee (20%).
Revenue.Performance Fees To FBYT: FBYT's protocol share of the performance fee (20%).
