ProtocolRevenue.Performance Fees To FBYT: FBYT's protocol share of the performance fee, sent to the FBYT admin wallet.
ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To FBYT: All trading fees, sent to the FBYT admin wallet.
ProtocolRevenue.Vault Creation Fees To FBYT: All vault creation fees, sent to the FBYT admin wallet.

SupplySideRevenue.Management Fees To Managers: The money manager's share of the management fee (80%).
SupplySideRevenue.Performance Fees To Managers: The money manager's share of the performance fee (80%).

methodology.Volume: USDC value of every share traded across all Seeryx prediction markets (shares times fill price), counted once per fill and excluding the exchange's own test trades.
methodology.Fees: Taker fees paid by traders whose orders fill against a resting order, at 7% x price x (1 - price) per share, minus fees refunded on trades that failed to settle on Solana; deposit and withdrawal fees are not included.
methodology.UserFees: Taker fees paid by traders on every fill, at 7% x price x (1 - price) per share, minus fees refunded on trades that failed to settle; makers pay no fee.
methodology.Revenue: Taker fees kept by Seeryx after paying 20% back to makers as rebates and refunding fees on trades that failed to settle.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Taker fees kept by Seeryx after maker rebates and refunds, collected into the fee account of the Seeryx program on Solana; Seeryx has no token, so all of it goes to the protocol.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Rebates paid to market makers: 20% of each fill's taker fee goes to the trader whose resting order was filled.

Fees.Taker Fees: Taker fees on every fill (7% x price x (1 - price) per share, highest at 50 cents and near zero at 1 or 99 cents), minus fees refunded on trades that failed to settle.

UserFees.Taker Fees: Taker fees paid by traders on every fill (7% x price x (1 - price) per share), minus fees refunded on trades that failed to settle; makers pay no fee.

Revenue.Taker Fees To Protocol: Taker fees kept by Seeryx after the 20% maker rebates and refunds on trades that failed to settle.

ProtocolRevenue.Taker Fees To Protocol: Taker fees kept by Seeryx after maker rebates and refunds, collected into the fee account of the Seeryx program on Solana.

SupplySideRevenue.Maker Rebates: 20% of each fill's taker fee, paid to the trader whose resting order was filled.

methodology.Fees: The 2% fee on every buy and sell of a coin launched on Sapling, the flat fee paid to plant a coin, and Sapling's fee on buys, plantings and sales made from a Zcash account. On Robinhood Chain: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee on every buy and sell of a coin planted through Sapling, both paid to Sapling's splitter, plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee, paid in USDG to the treasury. On Raydium LaunchLab (from 2026-10-28): any platform fee claimed from the curve and Sapling's fees from the coin's graduated pool; excludes the coin's transfer tax (Sapling's 2.00% plus the deployer's tax of none to 3%), which is taken on every transfer of the coin, wallet to wallet included.
methodology.Revenue: The part of the 2% coin trading fee Sapling keeps (10% treasury, 25% $SAPLING buyback and burn, 25% $SAPLING/ZEC liquidity), plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee. For LaunchLab coins, all of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees (a quarter each to the treasury, the flywheel, $SAPLING buyback and burn, and the protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool). On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury's share: 10% of the 2% coin trading fee, plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee. For LaunchLab coins, the treasury's and the flywheel's quarters of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees. On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 50% of the 2% coin trading fee: 25% buys and burns $SAPLING, and 25% goes to the $SAPLING/ZEC pool on PumpSwap, where about half of it buys $SAPLING, both sides are deposited and the LP tokens are burned, so no one, Sapling included, can withdraw it. On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee. For LaunchLab coins, half of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees: $SAPLING buyback and burn, and the protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool, whose position is locked for good.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 40% of the 2% coin trading fee, paid to each coin's deployer, a wallet they choose, or the holders of that coin as holder rewards (on Robinhood Chain, 40% of what reaches Sapling's splitter). LaunchLab coins pay their deployers from the coin's transfer tax, which is not counted.

Fees.Coin Trading Fees: The 2% fee on every buy and sell of a coin launched on Sapling, collected and split on chain by the Sapling vault program. On Robinhood Chain: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee, paid to Sapling's splitter and split there. For LaunchLab coins: any platform fee claimed from the curve and Sapling's fees from the graduated pool, both in ZEC (the coin's transfer tax is not counted).
Fees.Zcash Account Fees: Sapling's fee on a buy, planting or sale made from a Zcash account.
Fees.Coin Planting Fees: The flat fee paid to the Sapling treasury when a coin is planted, in the same transaction that creates the coin.

Revenue.Coin Trading Fees To Treasury: 10% of the 2% coin trading fee, sent to the Sapling treasury. On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
Revenue.Coin Planting Fees To Treasury: The flat planting fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
Revenue.Zcash Account Fees To Treasury: The Zcash account fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
Revenue.Sapling Coins Buyback And Burn: A quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees of LaunchLab coins, spent buying back and burning the top Sapling coins.
Revenue.Token Buy Back: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, used to buy $SAPLING and burn it (burned directly for coins paired with $SAPLING). On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
Revenue.$SAPLING/ZEC Liquidity: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, added to the $SAPLING/ZEC pool on PumpSwap: about half of it buys $SAPLING, both sides are deposited and the LP tokens are burned, so no one, Sapling included, can withdraw it (held in a vault per coin before 2026-10-02, then moved into the same liquidity). On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees, added to a protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool whose position is locked for good.

ProtocolRevenue.Coin Trading Fees To Treasury: 10% of the 2% coin trading fee, sent to the Sapling treasury. On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
ProtocolRevenue.Coin Planting Fees To Treasury: The flat planting fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Zcash Account Fees To Treasury: The Zcash account fee, sent to the Sapling treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Sapling Coins Buyback And Burn: A quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees of LaunchLab coins, spent buying back and burning the top Sapling coins.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, used to buy $SAPLING and burn it (burned directly for coins paired with $SAPLING). On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees.
HoldersRevenue.$SAPLING/ZEC Liquidity: 25% of the 2% coin trading fee, added to the $SAPLING/ZEC pool on PumpSwap: about half of it buys $SAPLING, both sides are deposited and the LP tokens are burned, so no one, Sapling included, can withdraw it (held in a vault per coin before 2026-10-02, then moved into the same liquidity). On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter. For LaunchLab coins, a quarter of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees, added to a protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool whose position is locked for good.

SupplySideRevenue.Coin Trading Fees To Deployers: 40% of the 2% coin trading fee, paid to the coin's deployer or a wallet they choose. On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter.
SupplySideRevenue.Coin Trading Fees To Coin Holders: 40% of the 2% coin trading fee of coins whose deployer chose holder rewards, paid in ZEC to the holders of that coin. On Robinhood Chain the share is of what reaches Sapling's splitter.
SupplySideRevenue.Coin Trading Fees To Deployers Or Coin H: On Robinhood Chain, the 40% share of fees Pons's escrow held before a sweep tied them to a coin, paid later to that coin's deployer or holders.

methodology.Fees: Fees users pay Veil to shield tokens into its private pool, withdraw them, swap privately or fill a private DCA order, plus Veil's share of the relayer fee; network fees, Jupiter's swap fees and tokens swept from closed DCA escrows are not included.
methodology.UserFees: Fees users pay Veil to shield tokens into its private pool, withdraw them, swap privately or fill a private DCA order, plus Veil's share of the relayer fee they pay.
methodology.Revenue: All fees users pay Veil for shielding, withdrawals, private swaps and private DCA fills, plus its share of the relayer fee, all kept by Veil as it has no liquidity providers or stakers to pay.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All fees users pay Veil, collected into the Veil treasury, minus the $VEIL the treasury buys back and burns with 20% of revenue, so it is negative on days when more is burned than earned.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: $VEIL bought on the market with 20% of Veil's revenue and burned, counted from the buyback wallet's on-chain burns at the token's price.

Fees.Shield Fees: The fee charged when tokens are shielded into Veil's private pool (0.3% of the amount in October 2026).
Fees.Withdrawal Fees: The fee charged when tokens are withdrawn from Veil's private pool to a public address (0.3% of the amount in October 2026).
Fees.Private Swap Fees: The fee charged on a swap made from inside Veil's private pool (0.3% of the input in October 2026).
Fees.Relayer Fee Share: Veil's share of the fee paid to the relayer that submits private transactions for the user.
Fees.Flow DCA Fees: The fee charged on each fill of a private DCA (Flow) order.

UserFees.Shield Fees: Paid by the user shielding tokens into Veil's private pool.
UserFees.Withdrawal Fees: Paid by the user withdrawing tokens from Veil's private pool.
UserFees.Private Swap Fees: Paid by the user making a swap from inside Veil's private pool.
UserFees.Relayer Fee Share: Paid by the user as part of the relayer fee.
UserFees.Flow DCA Fees: Paid by the owner of the private DCA order on each fill.

Revenue.Shield Fees To Treasury: All shield fees, collected into the Veil treasury.
Revenue.Withdrawal Fees To Treasury: All withdrawal fees, collected into the Veil treasury.
Revenue.Private Swap Fees To Treasury: All private swap fees, collected into the Veil treasury.
Revenue.Relayer Fee Share To Treasury: Veil's share of relayer fees, collected into the Veil treasury.
Revenue.Flow DCA Fees To Treasury: All private DCA fees, collected into the Veil treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Fees To Treasury: All fees collected into the Veil treasury, a Squads multisig, minus the $VEIL bought back and burned with 20% of revenue.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: $VEIL bought on the market with 20% of Veil's revenue and burned by the buyback wallet, valued at the token's price.

methodology.Fees: EVM chains: swap fees of the pools sasa creates for every coin, counted when sasa's builder collects them: the quote-asset side (ETH, BNB or USDC) and the coin side (in the launched coin, valued where the coin has a price). Solana: the creator fees of coins launched on sasa (both halves).
methodology.UserFees: Traders pay the pool's swap fee (EVM) or the launch curve's creator fee (Solana) on every buy and sell.
methodology.Revenue: EVM: 70% of the collected swap fees, sent to sasa's fee vault. Solana: sasa's 50% of the creator fees, received by its treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: EVM: 70% of the collected swap fees, sent to sasa's fee vault. Solana: sasa's 50% of the creator fees, received by its treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: EVM: 30% of the collected swap fees, sent to each coin's creator, or used to buy back and burn the coin when its creator chose buybacks. Solana: the creators' 50% of the creator fees.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees of sasa-created Uniswap V4 / PancakeSwap Infinity pools, both sides, as collected by the builder (FeesCollected).
Fees.Creator Fees: Solana: creator fees of coins launched on sasa, shared 50/50 between sasa and the coin's creator.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees traders pay on every buy and sell in sasa-created pools.
UserFees.Creator Fees: Solana: the creator fee traders pay on every buy and sell of a coin launched on sasa.

Revenue.Swap Fees to sasa: 70% of collected swap fees, sent to sasa's fee vault.
Revenue.Creator Fees to sasa: Solana: sasa's 50% of the creator fees, received by its treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees to sasa: 70% of collected swap fees, sent to sasa's fee vault.
ProtocolRevenue.Creator Fees to sasa: Solana: sasa's 50% of the creator fees, received by its treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees to Creators and Buybacks: 30% of collected swap fees, sent to the coin's creator or used for its buy-and-burn.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees to Creators: Solana: the creators' 50% of the creator fees.

methodology.Fees: Platform fees on every token and stock token trade made in Onagi: on Robinhood Chain paid in USDG into the Onagi fee vault, on Solana paid in USDC into the Onagi Solana fee account inside each Jupiter swap. Plus all Pons V2 swap fees and creator tax charged on ONAGI token trades (curve and graduated pool sweep events). Platform fees include a small reimbursement for network gas that Onagi pays on behalf of users, which is not separated on chain.
methodology.UserFees: Platform fees paid on every token and stock token trade made in Onagi (USDG on Robinhood Chain, USDC on Solana), plus all Pons V2 swap fees and creator tax charged on ONAGI token trades (curve and graduated pool sweep events).
methodology.Revenue: Platform fees plus the creator share of ONAGI token swap fees that Pons credits to Onagi.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The Pons protocol and Pons buyback share of ONAGI token swap fees, not kept by Onagi.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 75% of Robinhood Chain revenue: 50% is paid to eligible ONAGI holders in USDG and 25% buys ONAGI and sends it to the burn address. Computed from Onagi's published split.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 25% of Robinhood Chain revenue goes to the Onagi treasury. Solana platform fees stay in Onagi's Solana fee account, outside the holder split, so all of them are protocol revenue.

Fees.Platform Trading Fees: USDG fees paid into the Onagi fee vault on every Robinhood Chain token and stock token trade, including gas reimbursement; USDC received by the Onagi Solana fee account in each Jupiter swap.
Fees.ONAGI Token Swap Fees: protocolAmount + buybackAmount + creatorAmount from FeesSwept on the ONAGI curve and PoolFeesSwept for the ONAGI pool, in ETH.

Revenue.ONAGI Token Swap Fees To Onagi: creatorAmount of each ONAGI sweep, credited to Onagi in the Pons fee escrow.

SupplySideRevenue.ONAGI Token Swap Fees To Pons: protocolAmount + buybackAmount of each ONAGI sweep.

HoldersRevenue.Holder Payouts: 50% of revenue, paid to eligible ONAGI holders in USDG.
HoldersRevenue.Token Buyback And Burn: 25% of revenue, used to buy ONAGI and burn it.

ProtocolRevenue.Treasury: 25% of Robinhood Chain revenue, kept by the Onagi treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Solana Platform Fees To Treasury: All Solana platform fees, kept in the Onagi Solana fee account.

methodology.Fees: Fees paid by traders of tokens launched on Grainpad (Solana): Grainpad's platform fee (0.75% under its current config) and the token creator's fee (0.25%) on every trade against the Raydium LaunchLab bonding curves it configures, and, once a token graduates, the quote-side trading fees of its permanently locked liquidity, harvested with the Fee Keys Grainpad holds, plus the creator fee of those graduated pools, counted when the launch's creator claims it. Raydium's own protocol fee and the token transfer taxes of Grainpad reward launches are excluded. Amounts are in each pool's quote token, mostly wXMR.
methodology.UserFees: Grainpad's platform fee and the creator's fee on every Grainpad bonding-curve trade, plus the quote-side trading fees of graduated launches' locked liquidity and the creator fee of their pools, all paid by traders.
methodology.Revenue: The platform fee and the harvested locked-liquidity fees, both received by Grainpad.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform fee on bonding-curve trades and the harvested locked-liquidity fees, all received by Grainpad.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator fee of each bonding-curve trade and of each graduated pool, paid to the wallet that launched the token.

Fees.Trading Fees: Platform fee plus creator fee on every LaunchLab bonding-curve trade of a Grainpad launch (1% under the current config), charged in the pool's quote token.
Fees.LP Fees: Quote-token fees harvested from the locked liquidity of graduated Grainpad launches.
Fees.Creator Fees: The quote-side creator fee of graduated Grainpad launches' Raydium CPMM pools, counted when the launch's creator claims it.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The platform fee on bonding-curve trades, kept by Grainpad.
Revenue.LP Fees To Protocol: The harvested locked-liquidity fees, kept by Grainpad.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The platform fee on bonding-curve trades, received by Grainpad.
ProtocolRevenue.LP Fees To Protocol: The harvested locked-liquidity fees, received by Grainpad.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Creators: The creator fee on bonding-curve trades, paid to the wallet that launched the token.
SupplySideRevenue.Graduated Pool Creator Fees To Creators: The creator fee of graduated pools, claimed by the wallet that launched the token.

methodology.Fees: pump.fun creator fees of coins launched through Furnace, paid by traders and split on-chain by the Furnace program. Excludes the founder's half of $FURN's own creator fees and coins whose fees go to a person through pump.fun fee sharing directly, since neither passes through a Furnace coin vault.
methodology.UserFees: pump.fun creator fees paid by traders of coins launched through Furnace, split on-chain by the Furnace program.
methodology.Revenue: The Furnace treasury share and the $FURN buyback & burn share of the creator fees of coins launched through Furnace, plus the part of $FURN's own creator fees held by its vault, all of which buys back and burns $FURN.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 10% Furnace treasury share of each coin's creator fees, after the 30% of it paid to the coin's referrer when it has one.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Creator fees spent on buying back and burning $FURN: 10% of every coin's creator fees, plus the part of $FURN's own creator fees held by its vault.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator fees paid to the holders of each launched coin, spent on buying back and burning that coin, vested to its creator, or paid to its referrer.

Fees.Creator Fees: pump.fun creator fees split by the sweep instruction (Swept event amount), booked on the sweep date because the program records no earlier accrual date; fees can wait in a coin's Furnace vault until it holds at least 0.02 SOL.

UserFees.Creator Fees: pump.fun creator fees split by the sweep instruction (Swept event amount), booked on the sweep date because the program records no earlier accrual date; fees can wait in a coin's Furnace vault until it holds at least 0.02 SOL.

Revenue.Creator Fees To Treasury: Furnace treasury share of each coin's creator fees, after the referrer's cut.
Revenue.Creator Fees To FURN Buyback And Burn: Creator fees routed to $FURN buyback & burn: 10% of every coin's fees plus $FURN's own vault share.

ProtocolRevenue.Creator Fees To Treasury: Furnace treasury share of each coin's creator fees, after the referrer's cut.

HoldersRevenue.FURN Buyback And Burn: Creator fees that buy $FURN on its pump.fun curve or PumpSwap pool and burn it.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Coin Holders: Share of each coin's creator fees paid to that coin's holders (or to the single recipient of a fees-to-a-person coin).
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Coin Buyback And Burn: Share of each coin's creator fees spent on buying back and burning that same coin.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Coin Creators: Share of each coin's creator fees vested to its creator.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Referrers: 30% of the Furnace treasury share, paid to the referrer of a coin that has one.

methodology.UserFees: Close, liquidation and borrow fees paid by perp and expiry-future traders, and deposit and withdrawal fees paid by liquidity providers.
methodology.Fees: Fees perp and expiry-future traders and liquidity providers pay Olive: perp and expiry-future close fees, liquidation fees, perp borrow fees, and deposit and withdrawal fees on the pools Olive's options and perps share. Option and chooser trading fees are counted in Olive's options listing.
methodology.Revenue: Olive's share of perp and expiry-future close, liquidation and liquidity fees: 25% of each fee since launch, set per pool on chain. Borrow fees go to liquidity providers in full.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Olive's share of perp and expiry-future close, liquidation and liquidity fees (25% since launch), collected into each pool's protocol fee account.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The liquidity providers' share of perp and expiry-future close, liquidation and liquidity fees (75% since launch), plus all borrow fees, kept by the pools.
methodology.Volume: Notional of every perpetual and expiry-future trade (opens, limit fills, closes, and take-profit and stop-loss fills) at its execution spot price. Liquidations and expiry settlements are not trades and are not counted.

Fees.Perps And Futures Close Fees: Fees on closing perpetual and expiry-future positions (perps and futures have no open fee).
Fees.Liquidation Fees: Fees charged when a perpetual or expiry-future position is liquidated.
Fees.Borrow Fees: Borrow fees perpetual positions pay for the pool liquidity they reserve, charged when a position is closed or liquidated.
Fees.Liquidity Fees: Fees liquidity providers pay on deposits and withdrawals.

UserFees.Perps And Futures Close Fees: Paid by perp and expiry-future traders on closing.
UserFees.Liquidation Fees: Paid out of the liquidated position.
UserFees.Liquidity Fees: Paid by liquidity providers on deposit and withdrawal.

Revenue.Perps And Futures Close Fees To Olive: Olive's share of perp and expiry-future close fees.
Revenue.Liquidity Fees To Olive: Olive's share of liquidity deposit and withdrawal fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Perps And Futures Close Fees To Olive: Olive's share of perp and expiry-future close fees.
ProtocolRevenue.Liquidity Fees To Olive: Olive's share of liquidity deposit and withdrawal fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Perps And Futures Close Fees To LPs: The pool's share of perp and expiry-future close fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Liquidation Fees To LPs: The pool's share of liquidation fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Fees To LPs: All borrow fees, kept by the pool.
SupplySideRevenue.Liquidity Fees To LPs: The pool's share of liquidity deposit and withdrawal fees.

methodology.Fees: Pump.fun and Raydium LaunchLab creator fees paid by traders of coins launched through Paygram, counted when Paygram collects them.
methodology.UserFees: Pump.fun and Raydium LaunchLab creator fees paid by traders of coins launched through Paygram.
methodology.Revenue: The 20% protocol share of the collected creator fees, used to buy back and burn $PAYGRAM.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 80% share of the collected creator fees owed to the @handle or the coin holders each coin was launched for.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Paygram keeps none of the creator fees in a treasury: its whole 20% share is used to buy back and burn $PAYGRAM.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The 20% protocol share of the collected creator fees, used to buy back and burn $PAYGRAM.

Fees.Creator Fees: Pump.fun and Raydium LaunchLab creator fees on coins launched through Paygram, collected by the Paygram router.

UserFees.Creator Fees: Pump.fun and Raydium LaunchLab creator fees paid by traders of coins launched through Paygram.

Revenue.Token Buy Back: 20% of the collected creator fees, used to buy back and burn $PAYGRAM.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Recipients: 80% of the collected creator fees, owed to the @handle (X, Telegram, GitHub or Fomo) or the coin holders each coin was launched for.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 20% of the collected creator fees, used to buy back and burn $PAYGRAM.

methodology.Fees: SOL tips traders pay to land transactions through Lunar Lander, at the tip accounts in Hello Moon's docs plus the 100 accounts that receive Axiom users' bribes (published by Circular and confirmed on-chain to be landed by Lunar); revenue is not reported because what Lunar pays validators and order-flow partners happens off-chain.

Fees.Transaction Landing Tips: Tips sent to the 10 Lunar Lander tip accounts in Hello Moon's docs (https://docs.hellomoon.io/reference/lunar-lander) and to the 100 Axiom bribe accounts listed at https://github.com/Circular-fi/axiom-lunar-addresses.

methodology.Fees: Creator fees from coins launched on OTC (Pump.fun bonding curve and PumpSwap), paid out by Pump.fun to OTC's fee wallet, plus the creator fees of the $OTC token itself, plus the 0.5 SOL surcharge paid on every Desk NFT mint (refundable account rent excluded). Meteora launches, whose fees are claimed in the quote token, are not tracked yet.
methodology.Revenue: Share of launcher fees, $OTC creator fees and Desk mint surcharges sent to the OTC protocol wallet, plus the launcher fees used to buy back and burn $OTC or paid as SOL dividends to $OTC holders.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Share of launcher fees sent to the OTC protocol wallet (12.5% since Oct 3 2026, 5% from Sep 13 to Oct 2, 15% from early September to Sep 12 and less in the first days after launch), plus the part of $OTC's own creator fees the Desk pot forwards to it (50% per the docs, less in earlier months), plus 0.05 SOL of each Desk mint surcharge.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Share of launcher fees used to buy back and burn $OTC (10% since Sep 12 2026, about 5% before) and SOL dividends paid to $OTC holders (5% of launcher fees from Sep 12 to Oct 2 2026).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Launcher fees spent on the reward tokens airdropped to each launcher coin's holders and the account rent those payouts need (67.5% of launcher fees since Oct 3 2026, 70% before), plus the Desk pot paid out to Desk NFT owners (10% of launcher fees, the $OTC creator fees left after the protocol's part, and 0.45 SOL of each Desk mint surcharge).

Fees.Creator Fees: Pump.fun and PumpSwap creator fees of OTC launcher coins, paid out by Pump.fun to OTC's fee wallet.
Fees.$OTC Token Creator Fees: Pump.fun and PumpSwap creator fees of the $OTC token, paid into the Desk pot.
Fees.Desk Mint Surcharge: 0.5 SOL surcharge paid on each Desk NFT mint (0.45 SOL to the Desk pot, 0.05 SOL to the protocol). Refundable account rent and the burned $OTC deposit are excluded.

Revenue.Desk Mint Surcharge: 0.05 SOL protocol share of each Desk NFT mint surcharge.
Revenue.Protocol Share: Launcher fee share and $OTC creator fee share sent to the OTC protocol wallet in the fee split transactions.
Revenue.Token Buy Back: Launcher fee share sent to the buyback wallet, which buys $OTC on Jupiter and burns it.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Share: Launcher fee share and $OTC creator fee share sent to the OTC protocol wallet in the fee split transactions.
ProtocolRevenue.Desk Mint Surcharge: 0.05 SOL protocol share of each Desk NFT mint surcharge.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Launcher fee share sent to the buyback wallet, which buys $OTC on Jupiter and burns it.

SupplySideRevenue.Launcher Coin Holder Rewards: Launcher fees left in the fee wallet after the split transfers, spent on the reward token (stocks, pre-IPO, yield tokens) airdropped to each coin's holders and on the account rent those payouts need.
SupplySideRevenue.Desk Pot: Launcher fee share and the $OTC creator fees left after the protocol's part, sent to the Desk pot and paid out to Desk NFT owners.
SupplySideRevenue.Desk Mint Surcharge: 0.45 SOL of each Desk NFT mint surcharge, sent to the Desk pot and paid out to Desk NFT owners.

methodology.UserFees: All option and chooser trading fees, paid by Olive's option traders.
methodology.Fees: Fees option and chooser traders pay Olive on opening and closing positions (market and limit orders, sell-backs and take-profit and stop-loss sells). Liquidity deposit and withdrawal fees on the pools Olive's options and perps share are counted in Olive's perps listing.
methodology.Revenue: Olive's share of option and chooser trading fees: 25% of each fee since launch, set per pool on chain.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Olive's share of option and chooser trading fees, collected into each pool's protocol fee account.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The liquidity providers' share of option and chooser trading fees (75% since launch), kept by the pools.
methodology.NotionalVolume: Notional of every option and chooser trade (market and limit buys, sell-backs, and take-profit and stop-loss sells) at the execution spot price, with puts valued at their strike. Exercises, expiry settlements and chooser conversions are not trades and are not counted.
methodology.PremiumVolume: Premiums of option and chooser trades before fees: what buyers paid (market and limit buys) and what the pool paid for contracts sold back (sell-backs and take-profit and stop-loss sells).

Fees.Options Trading Fees: Fees on opening and closing options and chooser options (market and limit orders, sell-backs and TP/SL sells).

UserFees.Options Trading Fees: Paid by option and chooser traders.

Revenue.Options Trading Fees To Olive: Olive's share of option and chooser fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Options Trading Fees To Olive: Olive's share of option and chooser fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Options Trading Fees To LPs: The pool's share of option and chooser fees.

methodology.Fees: The 0.50% fee on every swap made through NABLA, taken in SOL, USDC or USDT and paid into its Jupiter referral fee accounts.
methodology.UserFees: Traders pay the 0.50% fee on each swap made through NABLA.
methodology.Revenue: NABLA's 80% of the fees, claimed into its treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: NABLA's 80% of the fees, claimed into its treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Jupiter's 20% of the fees, kept as its referral program's share.

Fees.Integrator Fees: 0.50% integrator fee on swaps routed through Jupiter, paid into NABLA's Jupiter referral fee accounts.

UserFees.Integrator Fees: 0.50% integrator fee paid by traders on each swap made through NABLA.

Revenue.Integrator Fees: NABLA's 80% share of the integrator fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Integrator Fees: NABLA's 80% share of the integrator fees, claimed into its treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Referral Fees To Jupiter: Jupiter's 20% share of the fees, kept by its referral program.

methodology.Fees: Trading fees paid in USDC on coins launched through the Ride Launchpad, while they trade on their bonding curve and after they graduate to an AMM pool.
methodology.Revenue: Ride's share of the trading fees on coins launched through the Ride Launchpad: its cut of bonding curve fees and the AMM fees earned by its locked liquidity.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Ride's share of the trading fees on coins launched through the Ride Launchpad, kept by the protocol.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Trading fees on coins launched through the Ride Launchpad that are paid to the coins' creators and to the other liquidity providers in their AMM pools.

Fees.Launchpad Bonding Curve Fees: Trading fees on coins launched through the Ride Launchpad while they trade on their bonding curve.
Fees.Launchpad AMM Fees: Trading fees on launched coins after they graduate to an AMM pool.

Revenue.Launchpad Bonding Curve Fees To Protocol: Ride's share of bonding curve trading fees.
Revenue.Launchpad AMM Fees To Protocol: Ride's share of AMM trading fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Launchpad Bonding Curve Fees To Protocol: Ride's share of bonding curve trading fees.
ProtocolRevenue.Launchpad AMM Fees To Protocol: Ride's share of AMM trading fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Launchpad Bonding Curve Fees To Creators: The creators' share of bonding curve trading fees, shared with the coin's vault and stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.Launchpad AMM Fees To Other LPs: The share of AMM trading fees earned by the coin's other liquidity providers, mainly its own creator position, which is shared with the coin's vault and stakers.

methodology.Fees: 1.50% of every FusedPad trade on the Meteora bonding curve, plus the quote-token LP fees FusedPad's locked liquidity earns after a coin graduates to Meteora DAMM v2. Covers holder distributions, the $FUSED burn pot, coin-creator fees, Meteora's protocol fee and referral fees. Identified by bonding-curve configs whose fee_claimer is the fused_fee Global PDA.
methodology.UserFees: The 1.50% a trader pays on every FusedPad bonding-curve trade, plus FusedPad's LP fees on graduated coins.
methodology.Revenue: The ~0.20% of every FusedPad trade used to buy and burn $FUSED (half becomes locked $FUSED liquidity once auto-LP is enabled), plus the 0.90% holder distribution on $FUSED's own pool, which goes to $FUSED holders. No treasury cut.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Zero. FusedPad does not keep a treasury cut; its share of trading fees goes to $FUSED holders through buy-and-burn and $FUSED holder distributions.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The ~0.20% of every FusedPad trade used to buy and burn $FUSED (split into burn + permanently locked $FUSED liquidity once auto-LP is enabled), plus the 0.90% of every $FUSED trade paid out to $FUSED holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 0.90% paid out to holders of each launched coin, coin creator fees (~0.096%), Meteora's ~0.30% protocol fee, and referral fees paid to hosting frontends.

Fees.Trading Fees: The 1.50% fee on every FusedPad bonding-curve trade, plus the quote-token LP fees FusedPad's locked liquidity earns on graduated coins' Meteora DAMM v2 pools.

Revenue.Token Buy Back: $FUSED buy-and-burn funded by FusedPad trading fees.
Revenue.Locked $FUSED Liquidity: Permanently locked $FUSED liquidity funded by FusedPad trading fees (zero until auto-LP is enabled).
Revenue.$FUSED Holder Distributions: 0.90% of every $FUSED trade on FusedPad, paid out to $FUSED holders in SOL.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: $FUSED buy-and-burn funded by FusedPad trading fees.
HoldersRevenue.Locked $FUSED Liquidity: Permanently locked $FUSED liquidity funded by FusedPad trading fees (zero until auto-LP is enabled).
HoldersRevenue.$FUSED Holder Distributions: 0.90% of every $FUSED trade on FusedPad, paid out to $FUSED holders in SOL.

SupplySideRevenue.Coin Holder Distributions: 0.90% of every trade in a launched coin, paid out to holders of that coin in the quote asset.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: Coin creator share: 8% of the bonding-curve trading fee (~0.096% of volume) and 8% of FusedPad's LP fees after graduation.
SupplySideRevenue.Protocol Fees to Meteora: Meteora's ~0.30% protocol share of every bonding-curve trade.
SupplySideRevenue.Referral Fees: Part of Meteora's protocol share handed back to whichever interface hosted the swap.

methodology.Volume: SOL value of every buy and sell on the bonding curves of coins launched on highbar (Meteora DBC pools on highbar's configs), gross of fees, read from the DBC swap events. Trading after a coin graduates is Meteora DAMM v2 volume and is not counted. Double counted: Meteora DBC also lists this volume.
methodology.Fees: Everything traders pay on highbar bonding curves (a 1% fee, or on anti-sniper launches a fee starting at 25% and falling to 1% within the first minute), including Meteora's 20% share; the migration fee taken from a curve's SOL when a coin graduates (1% of the 85 and 150 SOL thresholds, none on the 250 SOL tier); and the SOL LP fees highbar's locked liquidity earns in graduated Meteora DAMM v2 pools, when claimed. Excludes graduated-pool fees paid in the launched coin, and the creator's and Meteora's share of graduated-pool fees.
methodology.UserFees: What traders pay: the bonding curve fee and the SOL graduated-pool LP fees claimed by highbar; not the migration fee, which comes out of the curve's reserve.
methodology.Revenue: highbar's share: 50%, 38% or 25% (85, 150 and 250 SOL tiers) of the 80% of the bonding curve fee Meteora does not keep, its share of the migration fee (all of it on the 85 SOL tier, half on the 150 SOL tier), and the claimed SOL LP fees of its locked liquidity in graduated pools.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: highbar's share of bonding curve fees, migration fees and SOL graduated-pool LP fees, all paid to the highbar partner wallet (fee claimer).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The coin creator's share of the bonding curve fee (50%, 62% or 75% of the 80% Meteora does not keep) and of the migration fee, Meteora's 20% protocol fee, and the referral fee Meteora pays the interface a swap names.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: The whole fee traders pay on every buy and sell on a highbar bonding curve, in SOL: 1%, or on anti-sniper launches 25% at launch decaying to 1% over 60 seconds. 80% is shared by the coin creator and highbar, 20% goes to Meteora.
Fees.Migration Fees: The migration fee taken when a curve graduates to Meteora DAMM v2: 1% of the 85 SOL or 150 SOL threshold, 0% on the 250 SOL tier.
Fees.Graduated Pool LP Fees: SOL LP fees earned by highbar's permanently locked liquidity in graduated Meteora DAMM v2 pools (1% pool fee), counted when claimed. Fees on buys are paid in the launched coin and are not counted.

UserFees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: The whole fee traders pay on every bonding curve trade.
UserFees.Graduated Pool LP Fees: SOL LP fees traders pay to highbar's locked liquidity in graduated pools, when claimed.

Revenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To highbar: highbar's share of the 80% of the bonding curve fee Meteora does not keep: 50% (85 SOL tier), 38% (150 SOL tier) or 25% (250 SOL tier).
Revenue.Migration Fees To highbar: highbar's share of the migration fee: all of it on the 85 SOL tier, half on the 150 SOL tier.
Revenue.Graduated Pool LP Fees To highbar: Claimed SOL LP fees of highbar's locked liquidity in graduated pools.

ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To highbar: highbar's share of the 80% of the bonding curve fee Meteora does not keep: 50% (85 SOL tier), 38% (150 SOL tier) or 25% (250 SOL tier).
ProtocolRevenue.Migration Fees To highbar: highbar's share of the migration fee: all of it on the 85 SOL tier, half on the 150 SOL tier.
ProtocolRevenue.Graduated Pool LP Fees To highbar: Claimed SOL LP fees of highbar's locked liquidity in graduated pools.

SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Creators: The coin creator's share of the 80% of the bonding curve fee Meteora does not keep: 50%, 62% or 75% by tier.
SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Meteora: Meteora's protocol fee: its 20% of the bonding curve fee, less the referral fee it pays.
SupplySideRevenue.Bonding Curve Referral Fees To Interface: The referral fee Meteora pays, out of its 20%, to the interface a bonding curve swap names.
SupplySideRevenue.Migration Fees To Creators: The coin creator's half of the migration fee on the 150 SOL tier.

methodology.Fees: Scrooge's fee, taken by ScroogeRouter from each swap's output (the fee field of Swapped and SwappedMany), plus the fee a site embedding Scrooge's swap widget charges on top through ScroogePartner (at most 1%). On swaps through Relay, Scrooge's app fee as Relay reports it paid to Scrooge's fee wallet: on swaps under Scrooge's referrer "scrooge.exchange" since 2026-10-29, and before then, when Scrooge's swaps carried no referrer, on the ones Relay filled for Scrooge's app, listed by id. On Solana, the SOL the swap paid Scrooge's fee wallet or its wrapped-SOL account. Fees of the underlying venues and pools are not included. Scrooge takes no fee on swaps through LI.FI.
methodology.Revenue: Scrooge's fee on each swap: taken by ScroogeRouter on Robinhood Chain, paid as Relay's app fee on swaps through Relay, and paid in SOL to Scrooge's Solana fee wallet on Solana. The fee a partner site adds goes to that site and is not included.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Scrooge's fee on swaps through Relay, paid as Relay's app fee, and on Solana, paid in SOL to Scrooge's Solana fee wallet: kept by Scrooge, not burned.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The fee a partner site charges in Scrooge's swap widget, paid to that site.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Scrooge's fee on swaps through ScroogeRouter on Robinhood Chain, which the fee wallet swaps into SCROOGE every 15 minutes and burns, counted when the fee is charged. Burns funded by Scrooge's launchpad fees, which reach the same wallet, are not included.

Fees.Swap Fees: Scrooge's fee on each swap, taken from the output by ScroogeRouter, paid through Relay as an app fee, or paid in SOL on Solana.
Fees.Partner Fees: The fee a site embedding Scrooge's swap widget adds on top, taken from the output by ScroogePartner.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Scrooge: Scrooge's swap fee on swaps through Relay and on Solana, kept by Scrooge.
Revenue.Token Buy Back: Scrooge's swap fee on ScroogeRouter swaps, spent buying SCROOGE to burn.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Scrooge: Scrooge's swap fee on swaps through Relay and on Solana, kept by Scrooge.

SupplySideRevenue.Partner Fees To Integrating Sites: Partner fees, paid to the sites that embed Scrooge's swap widget.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Scrooge's swap fee on ScroogeRouter swaps, which the fee wallet swaps into SCROOGE and burns (sends to 0x…dEaD).

methodology.UserFees: Fees paid by users
methodology.Fees: Imperial's trading fee on every open and close (0.5 bps of notional until September 22, 2026, 1 bps since), plus any builder fee an integrator adds to orders it submits, as charged on-chain in each fill's log record.
methodology.Revenue: Imperial's trading fee on every open and close (0.5 bps of notional until September 22, 2026, 1 bps since).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Imperial's trading fee on every open and close (0.5 bps of notional until September 22, 2026, 1 bps since), all kept by the protocol treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Builder fees paid to the integrators that submitted the orders.
methodology.Volume: Notional size of every trader fill on Imperial's perp markets (opens, increases and closes), read from the fill record each fill logs on Imperial's Solana program. Liquidations log a different record and are excluded. Each fill counts once.

Fees.Trading Fees: Imperial's fee charged on the notional of each open and close: 0.5 bps until September 22, 2026, 1 bps since.
Fees.Builder Fees To Integrators: Optional builder fee set by an integrator on orders it submits, capped at 10 bps of notional.

Revenue.Trading Fees: Imperial's trading fee: 0.5 bps until September 22, 2026, 1 bps since.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: Imperial's trading fee: 0.5 bps until September 22, 2026, 1 bps since.

SupplySideRevenue.Builder Fees To Integrators: Builder fees paid out to integrators.

methodology.Fees: USDG received by the H081 protocol treasury's fee-only USDG account: the 0.20% relay fee on relayed withdrawals and spends (sent out of the bank vault by the stipend_pool program) plus the 0.25% loan origination fee on funded loans (sent by the lender in stream_loan::fund). The treasury's USDG account receives nothing else from the protocol; transfers from or signed by the team's wallets (deployer, config authority, treasury multisig and its members, relayer hot wallet) are excluded. H081 token trading and creator fees are not protocol fees and are not counted (the H081 mint is excluded).

The treasury's USDG account receives nothing else from the protocol; transfers from or signed by the team's wallets (deployer, config authority, treasury multisig and its members, relayer hot wallet) are excluded. H081 token trading and creator fees are not protocol fees and are not counted (the H081 mint is excluded).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: USDG received by the H081 protocol treasury's fee-only USDG account: the 0.20% relay fee on relayed withdrawals and spends (sent out of the bank vault by the stipend_pool program) plus the 0.25% loan origination fee on funded loans (sent by the lender in stream_loan::fund). The treasury's USDG account receives nothing else from the protocol; transfers from or signed by the team's wallets (deployer, config authority, treasury multisig and its members, relayer hot wallet) are excluded.
